question: List the English names of all Pokémon types.
reference: SELECT name FROM type_names WHERE local_language_id = 9

question: How many Pokémon species are in generation 1?
reference: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon_species WHERE generation_id = 1

question: How many moves have a power above 100?
reference: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moves WHERE power > 100

question: What is the genus of Bulbasaur?
reference: SELECT genus FROM pokemon_species_names WHERE local_language_id = 9 AND name = 'Bulbasaur'

question: What abilities can Pikachu have? Give their English names.
reference: SELECT an.name FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id = p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id = 9 JOIN pokemon_abilities pa ON pa.pokemon_id = p.id JOIN ability_names an ON an.ability_id = pa.ability_id AND an.local_language_id = 9 WHERE sn.name = 'Pikachu' AND p.is_default = 1

question: How many Fire-type Pokémon are there, counting only default forms?
reference: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_types pt ON pt.pokemon_id = p.id JOIN types t ON t.id = pt.type_id WHERE t.identifier = 'fire' AND p.is_default = 1

question: Which Fire-type Pokémon has the highest base attack? Give its English name, counting only default forms.
reference: SELECT sn.name FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_types pt ON pt.pokemon_id = p.id JOIN types t ON t.id = pt.type_id AND t.identifier = 'fire' JOIN pokemon_stats ps ON ps.pokemon_id = p.id JOIN stats s ON s.id = ps.stat_id AND s.identifier = 'attack' JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id = p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id = 9 WHERE p.is_default = 1 AND ps.base_stat = (SELECT MAX(ps2.base_stat) FROM pokemon p2 JOIN pokemon_types pt2 ON pt2.pokemon_id = p2.id JOIN types t2 ON t2.id = pt2.type_id AND t2.identifier = 'fire' JOIN pokemon_stats ps2 ON ps2.pokemon_id = p2.id JOIN stats s2 ON s2.id = ps2.stat_id AND s2.identifier = 'attack' WHERE p2.is_default = 1)

question: What is the average base speed of Water-type Pokémon, counting only default forms?
reference: SELECT AVG(ps.base_stat) FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_types pt ON pt.pokemon_id = p.id JOIN types t ON t.id = pt.type_id AND t.identifier = 'water' JOIN pokemon_stats ps ON ps.pokemon_id = p.id JOIN stats s ON s.id = ps.stat_id AND s.identifier = 'speed' WHERE p.is_default = 1

question: Which Pokémon are both Fire and Flying type? Give English names, default forms only.
reference: SELECT sn.name FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id = p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id = 9 WHERE p.is_default = 1 AND p.id IN (SELECT pt.pokemon_id FROM pokemon_types pt JOIN types t ON t.id = pt.type_id WHERE t.identifier = 'fire') AND p.id IN (SELECT pt.pokemon_id FROM pokemon_types pt JOIN types t ON t.id = pt.type_id WHERE t.identifier = 'flying')

question: How many different moves can Pikachu learn?
reference: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pm.move_id) FROM pokemon_moves pm JOIN pokemon p ON p.id = pm.pokemon_id JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id = p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id = 9 WHERE sn.name = 'Pikachu' AND p.is_default = 1

question: What are the five Electric-type moves with the highest power? Give their English names, breaking ties alphabetically.
reference: SELECT mn.name FROM moves m JOIN types t ON t.id = m.type_id AND t.identifier = 'electric' JOIN move_names mn ON mn.move_id = m.id AND mn.local_language_id = 9 WHERE m.power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.power DESC, mn.name LIMIT 5

question: Which default-form Pokémon has the highest total of all its base stats? Give its English name.
reference: SELECT sn.name FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_stats ps ON ps.pokemon_id = p.id JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id = p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id = 9 WHERE p.is_default = 1 GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(ps.base_stat) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the English name of the Pokémon with the greatest weight among default forms?
reference: SELECT sn.name FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id=p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id=9 WHERE p.is_default=1 ORDER BY p.weight DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which type has the most moves? Give its English name.
reference: SELECT tn.name FROM moves m JOIN type_names tn ON tn.type_id=m.type_id AND tn.local_language_id=9 GROUP BY m.type_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is Charizard's base speed?
reference: SELECT ps.base_stat FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id=p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id=9 JOIN pokemon_stats ps ON ps.pokemon_id=p.id JOIN stats s ON s.id=ps.stat_id AND s.identifier='speed' WHERE sn.name='Charizard' AND p.is_default=1

question: How many Pokémon species evolve from another species?
reference: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon_species WHERE evolves_from_species_id IS NOT NULL

question: Which Pokémon species evolve from Eevee? Give English names.
reference: SELECT sn.name FROM pokemon_species s JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id=s.id AND sn.local_language_id=9 JOIN pokemon_species_names parent ON parent.pokemon_species_id=s.evolves_from_species_id AND parent.local_language_id=9 WHERE parent.name='Eevee'

question: How many baby Pokémon species are there?
reference: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pokemon_species WHERE is_baby=1

question: What is the English name of the move with the highest accuracy-free power, meaning the single highest power of any move?
reference: SELECT mn.name FROM moves m JOIN move_names mn ON mn.move_id=m.id AND mn.local_language_id=9 WHERE m.power=(SELECT MAX(power) FROM moves)

question: Which pokemon has the highest defense?
reference: SELECT sn.name FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id=p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id=9 JOIN pokemon_stats ps ON ps.pokemon_id=p.id JOIN stats s ON s.id=ps.stat_id AND s.identifier='defense' WHERE p.is_default=1 ORDER BY ps.base_stat DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who has the best defense stat?

question: Which pokemon is the fastest?
reference: SELECT sn.name FROM pokemon p JOIN pokemon_species_names sn ON sn.pokemon_species_id=p.species_id AND sn.local_language_id=9 JOIN pokemon_stats ps ON ps.pokemon_id=p.id JOIN stats s ON s.id=ps.stat_id AND s.identifier='speed' WHERE p.is_default=1 ORDER BY ps.base_stat DESC LIMIT 1

question: List all the fire type pokemon
